decisions.reason: The leadership pathway, base salary, and team-management role are subsequent advancement terms and do not change the independently defined trial qualification process, which already has a same-message MODIFY covering the 15-to-20-clip trial and its success condition.
The leadership-role changes do not alter which content may be used for trial clips; the same message's instruction to use Teyron's content is already represented by the candidate's existing MODIFY.
